definitions.explanation: A person in charge of directing military operations or leading an organized group. Also used for the leader of a rescue team, fire brigade, or similar unit.

examples.japanese: {指揮官|しきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{指揮官|しきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指揮|しき}した→指揮する：21994_shikisuru⟧。
examples.english: The on-site commander directed the rescue operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{指揮官|しきかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: A good commander must earn the trust of their subordinates.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧ (command/direction) + {官|かん} (officer/official).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{指揮官|しきかん}: supreme commander
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧{指揮官|しきかん}: field/on-site commander
- {指揮官|しきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: the commander issues an order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{司令官|しれいかん}→司令官：20907_shireikan⟧: commander-in-chief (higher rank, overall command)
- {隊長|たいちょう}: unit leader, captain (smaller unit)
- ⟦{指揮|しき}{者|しゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧: director, conductor (also used for orchestra conductors)

USAGE:
While primarily military, {指揮官|しきかん} is also used in non-military contexts such as disaster response, firefighting, and rescue operations.
